$comment: The harness's SPECIAL branches: long-lived data and cache branches a process writes and reads, as opposed to a feature or pull-request branch. Bean folio-assistant-32f6.
Owner, 2026-10-02, verbatim: "need to prefix 'special' branches with cat-, cat-qa-reports, cat-fhir-ast, cat-lean-cacje (or whatever), not sure if any more. gh-pages stays as is".

Owner, 2026-10-02, later the same day: special branches are `cat/<harness>/<name>` (note on bean folio-assistant-fs43, 'rename-script'). The branch path mirrors the named-subgraph IRI `<HARNESS>/<NAME>`, and one ruleset pattern, `cat/**`, covers them all. The `<harness>` segment must be a declared instance; cat-harness/scripts/tests/special-branches.test.ts checks it. The interim `cat-<name>` spellings are kept as LEGACY names, newest first, so a remote that still carries one resolves.

This file is the ONE declaration of the names. JSON rather than TypeScript so a shell or Python reader can use it, and so it is data rather than a module. The scripts and workflows that run inside a folio carry a copy of the prefix (a folio may restore a cache with no bun on the path); each copy is listed in `mirrors`, and cat-harness/scripts/tests/special-branches.test.ts fails if a copy disagrees.

RESOLUTION, for readers AND writers: the new `name` if it exists on the remote; else the first `legacy` name that exists; else the new `name`. Writers follow the readers' rule on purpose: a writer that created a cat- branch while the legacy one still existed would make the owner's rename (POST /repos/{o}/{r}/branches/{old}/rename, which keeps a redirect for the web and API but NOT for git fetch/push) fail, because its target would already exist.

REMOVING THE FALLBACK is bean folio-assistant-oycs: once every remote carrying a legacy name is renamed and one lake-cache-refresh cycle has run since, empty each `legacy` list and drop the fallback from each mirror.

INTERIM: bean folio-assistant-rva2 (arc fs43 P7) plans to declare every special branch with the `storage` field arc 3fva introduces on ContentDirectory. When that field is on main, this table folds into it.
gh-pages is listed so 'is this branch special?' has one answer. It is never renamed: GitHub Pages serves it by name.
